# Verify Basic

Verify the latest completed Run's exact candidate and every AC using risk-driven checks. Use `.pactile/framework/reuse-first-guide.md` to assess actual integration and maintenance cost; do not repeat unchanged research. An independent reviewer reports without fixing the candidate. Missing or stale evidence blocks acceptance. Load `.pactile/modules/verify-basic/contract.md` for Review and validation boundaries.
